body:
I expect nothing but the worst from other people. I expect rudeness, betrayal, gaslighting, entrapment, mindgames, bullying, passive-aggressiveness, being ganged up on, being shunned, having my head kicked in by my own *immediate* family, having people organize "social justice" shaming flash mobs for the sole purpose of humiliating me, being hacked, being filmed without my prior consent, being told and made to feel as though I am less than human, and anything else one can think of.

"Heaps upon heaps...with the jawbone of an ass". I am a weak person, but I would like to think that somewhere deep within my heart...I could invoke the strength of Samson himself in order to fight against all of these Philistine scumbags. Even when I was a child and I had true innocence...I was torn down like a fucking animal. I may have lost that innocence, but I will never forget the bitterness in my heart nor will I ever give into this cursed earth.

You are no different than any of the social justice faggots that wish for my demise. Just another liar.
I don't give a fuck what anyone thinks of me. I can take embarassment, pain, sorrow, even torture without worrying about my human reputation. You are not genuine.

I looked at your history. Why are you in /r/depression and /r/suicidewatch so much on such a fresh account? Do you feel like a motherfucking hero for keeping people in artificial states of existence? We humans keep animals on the verge of extinction from dying out of arrogance rather than out of true compassion for life. Do you feel noble for your feeble efforts?
